title: Add editor:// directory to filesystem dock.
body: A follow-up PR to my **_global plugin_** PR: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/111193. Also related to the second point of my proposal: https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/831#issuecomment-3355144722. Also solved the [third feature](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/111193#pullrequestreview-3648290048) proposed by @KoBeWi This PR added the `editor://` directory to the filesystem dock. Which can be interacted like the `res://` directory. This is for user to easily develop editor plugins. # Goal The goal of this PR is to make creating editor addons **easy**, by adding the editor resource path into the filesystem that can be interacted like the normal project resources. # Features - Resources can be opened, edited, and saved. - All file right click options work. - You can move/copy files between `editor://` directory and `res://`. - `editor://` folder color is permanently gray. (Perhaps a different unique color is better. Like the favorites uses white folder) - A button to toggle visibility of the editor directory (Not visible by default) . This is needed because the filesystem might look messy, and user will not be using it all the time. - Filtering work. - Creating new folders work. - Creating new resources work. - Add to favorites is working. # TODO - [x] Fix `ProjectSettings::localize_path` not implemented correctly. - [x] ~~Fix errors when moving files to `editor://`~~ Nevermind, that was just a plugin bug. - [x] Fix freezing when using filesystem dock layout other than the default one. - [x] Make creating new resources work. - [x] Make creating new script work. - [x] Add a button to hide the editor:// folders. - [x] Make adding to favorites work. - [x] Fix filesystem not scanning after creating script on `editor://` directory. - [x] Fix editor:// folder collapsed after filesystem scan. - [x] Fix filtering `editor://` files in split viewer mode not working properly.
